sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact standalone JUnit stateless-value worker site is outside managed J2EE. Eight locally owned workers execute64 independent fixed COPY-vector checks; all Futures join within5s, finally always shutdownNow and asserts awaitTermination within10s. Explicit bounded lifecycle avoids unbounded ExecutorService.close; no DB/driver/network/FS/native/Root/service action and no blanket Test exemption.

No J2EE executor or DB/FS/socket/native/Root operation. Implicit close would omit the finite cleanup postcondition required by this test.
